Ilhan Omar's Home Searched by US Authorities; Trump Comments

US authorities conducted a search of Representative Ilhan Omar's Washington D.C. home, during which a DNA sample was reportedly seized. Following the search, former President Donald Trump stated that Omar could be jailed and deported. Omar detailed the federal search of her home and indicated she might need to relocate for safety reasons. She also released a video seeking donations to counter Trump's actions, asserting that "We're not gonna be silenced" and accusing Trump of attempting to intimidate her before the midterms.
